item_short_desc: Take on tough clearing tasks with Rothco’s 18 Inch Machete. Designed for versatility, its well-balanced steel blade handles everything from thick jungle foliage to backyard overgrowth. The durable plastic handle is riveted to the steel tang for enhanced stability, providing a secure grip during extended use. A convenient lanyard hole on the handle allows for easy carrying or hanging. Whether you’re tackling overgrown trails or preparing firewood, this machete is built for reliable performance in any environment.
